status: ADR 0195: Blit Arabic Modern is the one Arabic companion for every outline text font; Blit Arabic Retro (Kawkab Mono) is retired.

rejected_candidates.Cascadia Mono 2407.24: Contextual alias generation cannot produce the single glyph required for Hibr's one-cell lam-alef presentation forms FEF5..FEFC; do not silently widen or substitute.
rejected_candidates.DejaVu Sans Mono 2.37: Lacks U+0670 superscript alef used in the vocalized religious specimen; not accepted as the Modern companion.
rejected_candidates.Vazir Code 1.1.2: Contextual alias generation does not produce the single glyph required for Hibr's lam-alef presentation forms.

policy: Preserve source Arabic outlines and OpenType positioning. Materialize missing presentation-form aliases using the pinned Unicode decomposition and HarfBuzz contextual shaping, never a second handwritten Arabic shaper. No Hibr changes or second bidi pass. Unrepresentable aliases are reported, not claimed complete.
